Chris Parker has been the drummer of choice for an astonishing array of jazz and pop artists. He currently leads his own ensembles and satisfies his love of the visual arts through sketching and watercolor painting.
Chris was interviewed via Zoom on January 5, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have drummer and visual artist Chris Parker with me today. I feel like if I was introducing your father I’d say the same thing except I might say, “visual artist and drummer.”
It is indeed. I don’t have an original thought in my head, I just sort of copied what my father did which was playing drums along with records and painting and drawing.
